title: OFFSET ( -1, ... ) is the previous row of the relation; the first row has none

source.quote: Returns a table that summarizes the total sales for each product category and calendar year, as well as the total sales for that category in the previous year.
source.supports: the page's first example has this shape: a DEFINE VAR relation from SUMMARIZECOLUMNS, ADDCOLUMNS over it, and SELECTCOLUMNS over OFFSET ( -1, ... ) for the previous year's value

derivation: Amount by year of OrderDate: 2023 = 100 + 40 + 20 + 50 = 210, 2024 = 200 + 30 + 100 = 330. The row before 2024 is 2023: 210. 2023 has no previous row, so OFFSET returns no row and the value is BLANK.
